title: Video by earnedits.motion
description:
The best product commercials don’t focus on the product 🖤

They focus on the feeling it creates ⚡

This After Effects project turns one of the world’s most recognizable brands into a premium SaaS-style product commercial. Elegant product renders, floating interface elements, feature highlights, animated statistics, bold typography ✨

Every transition reinforces the message. Every animation highlights a benefit. Every composition strengthens the brand 💡

Clean layouts, subtle gradients, and polished motion systems that keep it modern and memorable from start to finish 🎬

For consumer brands, startup launches, and premium product edits
